items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I played with Charlie for a while too.

ctx.x: And what does everybody call you? What does everybody call you? What does everybody call me?
Somebody call me Little Dad and Charlie sometimes. I'm calling him a bandit player and he's called a Little Dad.
And I'm Dick Allen. My name's Paul Crawford. Could we get your name down too, Ms. Ivor?
